代码必须以小写字母开头，可包含小写字母、数字、中划线: Code must start with a letter, can contain letters, numbers, hyphens
您真的要删除这个成员吗？: Are you sure you want to delete this member?
您真的要删除这个空间吗？: Are you sure you want to delete this space?
您真的要删除这个组织吗？: Are you sure you want to delete this organisation?
您真的要退出这个组织吗？: Are you sure you want to leave this organisation?
该平台暂未开放: This platform is not available yet
该空间下存在子空间，无法删除: Cannot delete a space that has child spaces
请先在项目列表中选择一个项目: Please select a project from the project list first
您真的要移除这个成员吗？: Are you sure you want to remove this member?
您真的要退出这个项目吗？: Are you sure you want to leave this project?
未选择组织或组织不可用，仅展示公开的设备点表: No organisation selected or unavailable; showing public point tables only.
确认删除设备点表: Are you sure you want to delete device point table "{{label}}"?
请填写厂家与型号: Please fill in the manufacturer and model
由功能码与起始地址换算: derived from function code and start address
偏移从 0 起、不可修改，与线圈一一对应: Offset is auto from 0, one per coil
寄存器地址由起始地址按类型跨度自动连续排布: Register addresses are laid out contiguously from the start address by type span
拖拽表格行可调整功能码顺序: Drag table rows to reorder function codes
请先设置从站地址: Please set the slave address first
命令数据不完整，无法生成请求帧: Command data is incomplete, cannot generate a request frame
完整请求帧，含从站地址与 CRC16: Full request frame incl. slave address and CRC16
确认删除功能码: Are you sure you want to delete function code "{{label}}"?
输入 DTU 的 15 位 IMEI，解析后添加到当前项目: Enter the DTU's 15-digit IMEI; it will be parsed and added to the current project
请先删除其子设备: Please delete its child devices first
您真的要删除这个设备吗？: Are you sure you want to delete this device?
设备不存在或无权访问: Device not found or access denied
该设备下还没有服务: This device has no services yet
这份服务里还没有方法: This service has no methods yet
写方法：应答为请求回显，没有返回字段（设备已收到该帧）: Write method: the response echoes the request and has no return fields (the device has received the frame)
写方法（应答为请求回显，无返回字段）: Write method (the response echoes the request, no return fields)
请求帧将由该设备发出: The request frame will be sent by this device
默认取所选点表的描述，可修改: Defaults to the selected point table's description; editable
依赖设备没有可用的方法（Service → Action），无法定义服务: The dependent device has no usable methods (Service → Action), so a service cannot be defined
选择依赖设备上承载数据的服务: Select the service on the dependent device that carries the data
选择承载请求帧的方法: Select the method that carries the request frame
自动取所选方法的唯一入参，取不到按 0 落库，不可填写: Taken automatically from the selected method's single input; 0 is stored when unavailable. Not editable.
选择要映射的设备点表: Select the device point table to map
取不到源点表（可能已删除或不属于本组织），下面按服务里存的原样展示，保存不会改动: Source point table unavailable (it may have been deleted or belong to another organisation). The values stored in the service are shown as-is and will not be changed on save.
下列动作数据不完整，已跳过：: The following actions have incomplete data and were skipped:
选择源点表后，这里按功能码逐个列出将要生成的只读方法: After selecting a source point table, the read-only methods to be generated are listed here by function code
您真的要删除这个服务吗？: Are you sure you want to delete this service?
请填写服务名称，并选择依赖设备的方法与源点表: Please enter a service name and select the dependent device's method and source point table
源点表里没有可用的功能码动作，生成不出方法: The source point table has no usable function-code actions; no methods can be generated
无法访问摄像头，请使用手动添加: Cannot access the camera; please add manually
完整应答帧，含从站地址与 CRC16: Full response frame incl. slave address and CRC16
数据区为示例值，真实数据由设备返回: The data area shows sample values; the real data is returned by the device
功能码最高位置 1 表示异常；异常码与 CRC16 由设备返回，此处以 ?? 占: A set high bit in the function code means an exception; the exception code and CRC16 are returned by the device and shown as ?? here
01 非法功能码 / 02 非法数据地址 / 03 非法数据值 / 04 从站设: 01 Illegal function / 02 Illegal data address / 03 Illegal data value / 04 Slave device failure
生成服务时作为应答字段名: Used as a response field name when the service is generated
留空则该位不单独出值，仍可从整段位掩码读: Leave blank: this bit gets no value of its own and is read from the whole bitmask
未逐位命名，只按整段位掩码读: No bit named individually; read from the whole bitmask
同一应答里的取值名不能重复: Value names within one response must be unique
方法由源点表生成（一个功能码动作 = 一个方法），除自动轮询、调用周期与逐字段告: Methods are generated from the point table (one function-code action = one method); everything is read-only except automatic polling, the call interval and per-field alarms
留空 = 不自动调用，只手动调用；写方法不能自动调用: Leave blank = no automatic call, manual only; write methods cannot be called automatically
启用 = 服务端按调用周期自动调用；停用 = 暂停（周期保留）: Enabled = the server calls it automatically on the call interval; Disabled = paused (interval kept)
数据点较多，已按时间区间降采样（值为该段平均值，括号内为最小~最大值）: Many data points; downsampled by time interval (the value is the average for that interval, in parentheses minimum~maximum)
竖线为采集失败时刻: Vertical lines mark when collection failed
异常记录超过上限，只列出最近的部分: There are more exception records than the limit; only the most recent ones are listed
选中的字段太多，曲线图只展示前若干个；用「字段」缩小选择: Too many fields selected; the chart shows only the first few. Narrow the selection with Fields
只有读方法的字段可以配置告警: Only fields of read methods can have alarms configured
文本字段不能配置告警: Text fields cannot have alarms configured
启用 = 出值越限时记一条告警；停用 = 不告警（配置保留）: Enabled = an alarm is recorded when the value goes out of range; Disabled = no alarm (configuration kept)
一个出值可以配多条规则，同时命中时只有级别最高的那条生效；级别相同时排在下面的那: One output value can have multiple rules. When several match at the same time, only the one with the highest level takes effect. When levels are equal, the lower rule wins.
只有管理员可以修改告警配置: Only administrators can modify the alarm configuration
点击模型上新的位置: Click the new position on the model
点击模型表面可标注空间: Click the model surface to annotate a space
该空间暂无设备: No devices in this space yet
空间已创建，但没有返回空间 ID，标注未生效: Space created, but no space ID was returned, so the annotation was not applied
